pages.text: One day, the children noticed something interesting on the garden fence.
The fence colors went red, blue, red, blue, red, blue.
They realized the colors were repeating in a pattern.
A pattern happens when something repeats in the same order.
Then they saw stepping stones shaped like circle, square, circle, square.
Circle, square, circle, square. What shape comes next?
It must be a circle! The pattern keeps going.
They heard a bird singing: chirp, chirp, pause. Chirp, chirp, pause.
Patterns were everywhere — in stripes, music, and even footsteps.
From that day on, they could predict what would happen next just by noticing the pattern.
